parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, act.molregno || '_' || act.assay_id || '_' || act.record_id AS compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.description AS assay_description, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, NULLIF(act.activity_comment, 'Not Active') AS activity_comment, t.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, t.pref_name AS target_name, t.organism AS target_organism FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON m.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a.tid = t.tid WHERE t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1980' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY m.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, a.description, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, activity_comment, t.chembl_id, t.pref_name, t.organism
